title: Episode 118 Close: Basoli Captives, Uncertain Death Toll, and the Turn to Shah Nawaz

blocks.text: This fragment gathers the fate of those who did not escape. Captives from Parol and the men who collapsed in the hills are carried into Basoli jail and severed heads are displayed as trophies, reducing the massacre to an inventory of humiliation as well as death.

The page emphasizes how little of the Khalsa remnant remained. Only a small number survive, very few horses are left, and even the poet admits that the total slaughter could not be counted exactly because the dead lay scattered across many routes of flight and capture.

The closing lines date the great disaster and pivot to the next moral sequence. After recounting the uncertain death toll, the narrative turns toward the destined downfall of Lakhpat Rai and Shah Nawaz, whose pride and cruelty invite their own destruction.
